general.title: Shopproof
general.description: EU rules for the countries you sell to

overview.disclaimer: Technical information to help shops comply. Not legal advice.
overview.loadFailed: The rules could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.
overview.notYet: The rules list that ships with the plugin is missing. Reinstall the plugin, or press "Check for rule updates now".
overview.countriesHint: Choose the countries you sell to under Extensions > My extensions > Shopproof EU Compliance > Configure. EU-wide rules are always shown.
overview.versionBundled: Rules version {version}, shipped with the plugin.
overview.autoOff: Shopproof works without contacting any server. To get rule changes as they are published, press "Check for rule updates now" or turn on "Download rule updates once a day" in the plugin settings. The download goes to the Shopproof rules service and sends no shop, customer or personal data.
overview.autoOn: Rule updates are downloaded once a day from the Shopproof rules service. You can turn this off in the plugin settings.
overview.refresh_updated: Rules checked. The list below is the newest version.
overview.refresh_failed: The rules service could not be reached. The rules you already have stay in place; try again later.

withdrawal.checkFailed: The withdrawal button check could not be loaded. Try again.
withdrawal.unsupported: This Shopware version has no withdrawal button yet. Update to Shopware 6.7.9 or later to use it; Shopproof then keeps a record of every request.
withdrawal.allGood: Shopware's withdrawal button is set up in every active storefront.
withdrawal.needsWork: Shopware's withdrawal button still needs some setup.
withdrawal.where: Change these under Settings > Basic information (Legal and compliance: Show "Revoke a contract" button in footer; Shop pages: Shop page layout for revocation request) and Settings > Flow Builder. The sales channel can override each setting. Technical help, not legal advice.

check.flowActive: The flow "Online revocation request sent" is active, so emails go out
check.customerMail: The flow emails the shopper a confirmation with the request and its date and time
check.recordTable: Shopproof's table for the records exists (shopproof_withdrawal_request). If not, reinstall the plugin.
check.buttonOn: The withdrawal button is switched on
check.page: The button links to a withdrawal request page
check.form: That page has the withdrawal request form
check.labels: Every storefront language has the national button wording
check.labelsMissing: These storefront languages have no national button wording yet: {languages}. Set the button text under Settings > Snippets.
check.wording: The chosen button wording applies in every storefront language
check.wordingMissing: These storefront languages have no reviewed alternative wording, so they keep the national wording: {languages}.
check.wordingOwn: Your own button wording is not used yet: enter both texts and tick that you understand the legal wording (Shopproof settings, Withdrawal button card). Until then the national wording applies.
check.returnsUrl: Your returns tool address cannot be used, so withdrawals are not sent on. Enter the full https:// address your returns tool gave you (Shopproof settings, Returns tool card). Withdrawals are still recorded here.

withdrawal.listIntro: Every request sent through Shopware's withdrawal button, kept in this shop's database so you can show when it arrived. Shopproof never receives it.
withdrawal.searchLabel: Search by email, name or order number
withdrawal.listFailed: The withdrawal requests could not be loaded. Your user needs the right to view orders.
withdrawal.failedRecords: {count} withdrawal request could not be recorded; check the log and the Shopware emails. | {count} withdrawal requests could not be recorded; check the log and the Shopware emails.
withdrawal.failedHelp: Shopware still sent its emails, so the shopper got a confirmation, but the request is missing from the list below. Find it in the emails Shopware sent to the shop and in var/log (search for "Shopproof could not record"), and keep a copy.
withdrawal.deliveredHelp: The day the customer received the goods (the last item). Without it, the day Shopware marked the delivery as shipped stands in, which can only say "in time" or "check".
withdrawal.notEmailed: No email was sent (the setting is off, or the shop has no email address or template for this storefront).
withdrawal.statusFailed: The status could not be saved. Try again.
withdrawal.confirmStatus: Save this status? The customer gets an email about it, unless status emails are off in the settings.

clock.late: Late by {days} day: window ended {date} | Late by {days} days: window ended {date}
clock.check: Check: may be late, enter the delivery date
clock.unknown: Window unknown: enter the delivery date
clock.none: No refund clock while the withdrawal is late
clock.overdue: Refund overdue by {days} day (was due {date}) | Refund overdue by {days} days (was due {date})
clock.due: Refund due by {date} ({days} day left) | Refund due by {date} ({days} days left)
clock.help: Technical help, not legal advice. The window is 14 days (or your longer period) from delivery and runs to Monday when it ends on a weekend; public holidays can extend it too. The refund is due 14 days after the withdrawal arrived.

products.guaranteeNotice_ok: The EU legal guarantee notice is shown on product pages
products.guaranteeNotice_off: The EU legal guarantee notice is off in at least one storefront. It is required for goods from 27 September 2026. Turn on "Show the official EU legal guarantee notice on product pages" in the plugin settings.
products.manufacturerDetails_ok: Every manufacturer of your products has contact details for the product safety information
products.manufacturerDetails_off: These manufacturers have no contact details, so their products show the manufacturer's name only. Add the address and email under Catalogues > Manufacturers (Shopproof: product safety), or on each product:
products.hazardStatements_off: These products have hazard or precautionary statements the product page cannot show. Codes with a choice or a blank (such as P280 or P501) need your own words after a colon, for example "P280: Wear protective gloves.". Open the product, Custom fields, "Shopproof: hazardous chemicals (CLP)":
products.registrationNumbers_off: These lines of "Your registration numbers" in the plugin settings are not shown, because they have no colon or no number, or there are more than 12. Write them like "WEEE DE: DE 12345678":

cms.label: Shopproof product information
cms.previewText: Durability label, product safety, guarantee notice
cms.elementText: On the product page this shows the durability label, the product safety information and the EU legal guarantee notice, each where it applies. A block the buy box or the description already shows on the page is not repeated.
cms.configText: Nothing to set here. The content comes from each product and from the Shopproof settings under Extensions > My extensions > Shopproof EU Compliance > Configure.

layouts.title: Product pages
layouts.intro: Where Shopproof shows the durability label and the product safety line (in the buy box) and the guarantee notice and take-back information (below the product description), for each product page layout your shop uses.
layouts.missing: has no place for {blocks}. Open the layout and add the block "Shopproof product information" (category Commerce) where they should appear.

part.guarantee: the guarantee notice and take-back information

proof.title: Proof log
proof.intro: A dated record of what your shop showed and which withdrawals it received, kept in your shop's own database. Each entry is chained to the one before by a SHA-256 hash, so a changed or deleted entry shows up when you check the chain. It holds no customer names, email addresses or order numbers. A snapshot is recorded once a day.
proof.unavailable: The proof log table is missing. Update or reinstall the plugin.
proof.loadFailed: The proof log could not be loaded.
proof.none: No entries yet. The first snapshot is recorded within a day, or press "Record a snapshot now".
proof.retention: Entries are kept for {days} days (plugin settings, Proof log).
proof.retentionAll: All entries are kept (plugin settings, Proof log).
proof.verifyBroken: Chain broken at entry {id}, after {count} intact entries. An entry was changed or deleted.

returns.title: Returns tool
returns.intro: Shopproof can send each new withdrawal to your returns tool or automation as signed JSON, and add a link to your returns portal to the customer's receipt. Set the addresses in the Shopproof settings (Returns tool card).
returns.on: On: each new withdrawal is sent to your returns tool.
returns.off: Off: no webhook address is set.
returns.secretHelp: Paste this into your returns tool. Each request carries the header X-Shopproof-Signature: t=<time>,v1=<signature>. The signature is the HMAC-SHA256, in hex, of the time, a dot and the request body, keyed with this secret. Keep the secret private.
returns.renewed: New secret made. Paste it into your returns tool, since the old one no longer works.
returns.testOk: Your returns tool accepted the test (status {code}).
returns.testRefused: Your returns tool refused the test with status {code}. Check the address and the secret there.
returns.testUnreachable: Your returns tool could not be reached. Check the address.

delivery.retrying: Returns tool: not accepted {time} (status {code}). Shopproof will try again.
delivery.failed: Returns tool: gave up {time} (status {code}). Please create the return by hand.
